# lean-pkg register

the ONLY write path for new packages: validated, deduping, auto-detecting.

## Usage

```text
lean-pkg register [--url URL] --path PATH [--like OTHER] [--owner-project OWNER_PROJECT]
                  [--license-spdx SPDX] [--visibility {private,public}]
                  [--status {scratch,active,gate-pending,public}]
                  [--upstream-target {none,mathlib,palomar}] [--automation AUTOMATION]
                  [--notes NOTES] [--reason REASON] [--workspace WORKSPACE]
                  [--agent AGENT] [--ttl TTL] [--dry-run] [common flags] NAME
```

`[common flags]`: `--json`, `--commit`, `--push`, `--no-commit`, also accepted before the command name; see the [CLI overview](../cli.md).

## Arguments and flags

| Argument or flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `NAME` |   |
| `--url URL` | git URL (or local bare path); required unless --like gives it (old spelling --repo, kept working) |
| `--path PATH` | local checkout path, $HOME-relative. Required. |
| `--like OTHER` | a sibling of registered package OTHER: copy its repo, owner-project, upstream-target and automation (flags given here win; visibility is never copied, default private), and report whether the toolchain and Mathlib pin match OTHER's |
| `--owner-project OWNER_PROJECT` |   |
| `--license-spdx SPDX` | the package's license, an SPDX identifier or expression (Apache-2.0, MIT OR Apache-2.0); the page, the publish checklist and formalization.yaml read it (later: update --license-spdx) |
| `--visibility {private,public}` | Choices: `private`, `public`. Default: `private`. |
| `--status {scratch,active,gate-pending,public}` | public only with --visibility public and --reason (an already-public repo). Choices: `scratch`, `active`, `gate-pending`, `public`. Default: `active`. |
| `--upstream-target {none,mathlib,palomar}` | default none. Choices: `none`, `mathlib`, `palomar`. |
| `--automation AUTOMATION` |   |
| `--notes NOTES` |   |
| `--reason REASON` | required with --status public |
| `--workspace WORKSPACE` | metadata only; does NOT claim |
| `--agent AGENT` | metadata only; does NOT claim |
| `--ttl TTL` | accepted and ignored (register never claims; claim separately with `lean-pkg lease claim NAME --ttl H`) |
| `--dry-run` | print the would-be entry as YAML without writing |

## Details

| Form | What it does | Key flags |
|---|---|---|
| `register NAME` | the only write path for new packages; validated, deduping by name and by resolved checkout (`~/` expanded, relative paths taken from `$HOME`, stored `$HOME`-relative), auto-detects toolchain and Mathlib pin; a Lean root namespace (each `lean_lib` in `lakefile.lean` or `lakefile.toml`, else the top-level `*.lean` files) that another registered package's checkout also uses is a stderr note and a `notes` entry in `--json`, never a refusal; an empty `--path`, `--repo` or `--owner-project`, or a path resolving to `$HOME`, is refused; a `--path` that does not exist on this host is only a warning (`warn: local_path does not exist on this host`), and `lean_toolchain` and `mathlib_pin` are then recorded as null: fix the path later with `update NAME --path DIR --reason R`, then `update NAME --redetect`. NAME is the package name every later command takes. `--like OTHER` registers a sibling of a registered package (for example `lean-r2/` beside `lean/` in one manuscript repository; see [Sibling packages](../receipts.md#sibling-packages-in-one-repository)): `repo`, `owner_project`, `upstream_target` and `automation` are taken from OTHER unless given (visibility is never copied: it defaults to `private`); copying OTHER's `repo` is refused when both checkouts are on this host in different git repositories and `--repo` is absent (nothing written); a stderr note says whether the detected toolchain and Mathlib pin match OTHER's, never a refusal; `--json` gains `like` {name, copied[], toolchain {this, like, match}, mathlib_pin {this, like, match}} and the `registered` event `like`; an unknown OTHER is refused (exit 1); with neither `--repo` nor `--like` it is a usage error (exit 2). Warnings (`warn:` lines, `warnings[]` in JSON), never refusals: the checkout lies inside, or contains, another registered package's directory (every commit to the inner one is drift for the outer one's receipt); its `lake-manifest.json` has a path dependency outside the package directory (`gate` refuses that receipt) | `--repo URL` (or `--like OTHER`) `--path HOME-RELATIVE` `[--like OTHER]` `[--owner-project]` `[--visibility]` `[--status scratch|active|gate-pending|public]` (`public` needs `--visibility public` and `[--reason]`) `[--upstream-target none|mathlib|palomar]` `[--automation]` `[--notes]` `[--dry-run]` |

## Exit codes

0 success (dry runs and no-ops included), 1 refused or failed, 2 usage error; see [Exit codes](../cli.md#exit-codes).

## JSON output

Top-level keys of `--json`, as recorded in the golden contract (tests/golden/json-keys.json):

- `register` (exit 0): `dry_run`, `event`, `name`, `notes`, `package`, `warnings`
- `register-dry-run` (exit 0): `dry_run`, `name`, `notes`, `package`, `warnings`

## Examples

Print the entry that would be written, detected toolchain and Mathlib pin included; nothing is written.

```bash
lean-pkg register my-proof --url git@github.com:you/my-proof.git --path src/my-proof --license-spdx Apache-2.0 --dry-run
```

Register a new package from its checkout (the path is relative to $HOME); it starts at status active.

```bash
lean-pkg register my-proof --url git@github.com:you/my-proof.git --path src/my-proof
```

Sample output:

```text
my-proof: registered (status=active, visibility=private, toolchain=leanprover/lean4:v4.24.0, pin=?)
```
